description: It reads the sign-up form of one webinar the way a participant sees it, from the first field to the last. Each field comes with its label, its type (text, checkbox, textarea, dropdown or a hidden field), whether it is required, and whether it really shows up on the participant page. Take it when a host wonders what the form actually asks. "Wait, does my form ask for the phone number?" It needs the webinar id and only reads, so nothing on the site changes. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Change a field with wi_change_registration_fields. Words hosts use: registration form, sign up fields, form fields, asked data

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_get_registration_fields
title: Read the registration form fields
